integrity: Single mathematical claim, analytically proved with independent reproducible finite checks; possible unlocated earlier special-case probability calculations are a bibliographic risk.
scientific_limitations: Exact-arithmetic, fixed 2D trial space, 3D SPD family, independent dense real Gaussian sketches; no sparse-sketch or whole-method claim. The Gaussian-regression Student distribution is standard; only its exact nonreal-pair application and sharp asymptotic classification are assessed here.
title: Gaussian-sketch nonreal Ritz pairs: sharp coalescence and oversampling laws
